material.claim: Whether gm-mcp self-update (gm-mcp/src/self-update.js, .prev backup) may overwrite local windowsHide fixes, and which guard applies: (a) build-identity guard as the runner has, or (b) fix windowsHide upstream only.
material.deferReason: human decision required: let gm-mcp self-update overwrite local windowsHide fixes from the release channel vs guard self-update so local windowsHide fixes are preserved, current windowsHide matches in gm-mcp/src: 7
material.witness_evidence: AGENTS.md Implementation rules: self-update guards compare build identity (COMMIT, RELEASE_BUILD from build_info.rs), never the version string. Local windowsHide fixes must land in gm-mcp/src on main, so a self-update cannot overwrite them; no local-only patch survives an update.
